requirements.text: Patients must be able to book appointments online
Patients must be able to cancel or change appointments online
Patients must be able to request repeat prescriptions online
Patients must be able to view test results online after review by a healthcare professional
The portal must have a reminder system via text or email for upcoming appointments
The portal must have straightforward and clear navigation design
The portal must ensure security and compliance with regulations regarding patient data privacy
The portal should integrate smoothly with existing systems
The portal must reduce the volume of phone calls received from patients
The portal must alleviate patient anxiety regarding test results by allowing online access
The system must handle high volume of requests without significant delays
The system must provide timely notifications to patients regarding their appointments and prescriptions
